assertions: A new employment entry was created through the deployed Chrome profile editor with January 2024 and December 2025 selected.
Both native month controls displayed the intended values before save and the real profile save returned HTTP 200.
After a full reload, the same employment entry displayed 2024-01 and 2025-12 exactly; the year did not shift to 2026.
The persistent UAT employment entry is permitted test-environment data and provides durable regression evidence.
